Lord Brahma, the father of all creatures, has said that you did promise to preserve the three worlds.

संक्षिप्य च पुरा लोकान्मायया स्वयमेव हि
महार्णवे शयानोऽप्सु मां त्वं पूर्वमजीजनः

saṁkṣipya ca purā lokānmāyayā svayameva hi
mahārṇave śayāno'psu māṁ tvaṁ pūrvamajījanaḥ
Formerly when having slain all animals by your Maya you went asleep in the waters of the mighty deep I was born.

भोगवन्तं ततो नागमनन्तमुदके शयम्
मायया जनयित्वा त्वं द्वौ च सत्त्वौ महाबलौ

bhogavantaṁ tato nāgamanantamudake śayam
māyayā janayitvā tvaṁ dvau ca sattvau mahābalau

There after you did create the huge-bodied Ananta, living in the waters as the king of serpents. Then you did create two highly powerful Asuras named Madhu and Kaitabha. At that time the bones of those two Asuras having been scattered far and wide this earth containing many mountains was named Medini.

पद्मे दिव्यार्कसंकाशे नाभ्यामुत्पाद्य मामपि
प्राजापत्यं त्वया कर्म सर्वं मयि निवेशितम्

padme divyārkasaṁkāśe nābhyāmutpādya māmapi
prājāpatyaṁ tvayā karma sarvaṁ mayi niveśitam
Having procreated me in your lotus navel, dazzling in celestial brilliance you did employ me in the work of generation.

सोऽहं संन्यस्तभारो हि त्वामुपासे जगत्पतिम्
रक्षां विधत्स्व भूतेषु मम तेजस्करो भवान्

so'haṁ saṁnyastabhāro hi tvāmupāse jagatpatim
rakṣāṁ vidhatsva bhūteṣu mama tejaskaro bhavān

I took the charge and procreated men; but finding no other means to preserve them I worshipped you, the lord of the universe and said:-0 lord, you should protect the creatures, for you are my father and giver of energy and therefore irrepressible.

ततस्त्वमपि दुर्धर्षस्तस्माद्भावात्सनातनात्
रक्षार्थं सर्वभूतानां विष्णुत्वमुपजग्मिवान्

tatastvamapi durdharṣastasmādbhāvātsanātanāt
rakṣārthaṁ sarvabhūtānāṁ viṣṇutvamupajagmivān
Thereupon for concerning means for the preservation of creatures, you did renounce your irrepressible shape and assume Visnu form.

अदित्यां वीर्यवान्पुत्रो भ्रातॄणां हर्षवर्धनः
समुत्पन्नेषु कृत्येषु लोकसाह्याय कल्पसे

adityāṁ vīryavānputro bhrātṝṇāṁ harṣavardhanaḥ
samutpanneṣu kṛtyeṣu lokasāhyāya kalpase
And taking your birth from Aditi's powerful son, you went engaged in enhancing the delight of my brothers. You did use to protect the deities whenever they were assailed by any calamity.

स त्वं वित्रास्यमानासु प्रजासु जगतां वर
रावणस्य वधाकाङ्क्षी मानुषेषु मनोऽदधाः

sa tvaṁ vitrāsyamānāsu prajāsu jagatāṁ vara
rāvaṇasya vadhākāṅkṣī mānuṣeṣu mano'dadhāḥ
O lord of the universe, it is for that reason, on beholding the destruction of creatures you went born on earth to slay the Ten-necked demon.

दशवर्षसहस्राणि दशवर्षशतानि च
कृत्वा वासस्य नियतिं स्वयमेवात्मनः पुरा

daśavarṣasahasrāṇi daśavarṣaśatāni ca
kṛtvā vāsasya niyatiṁ svayamevātmanaḥ purā
And at that time you did promise that you would live in the land of mortals for eleven thousand years.

स त्वं मनोमयः पुत्रः पूर्णायुर्मानुषेष्विह
कालो नरवरश्रेष्ठ समीपमुपवर्तितुम्

sa tvaṁ manomayaḥ putraḥ pūrṇāyurmānuṣeṣviha
kālo naravaraśreṣṭha samīpamupavartitum
There upon you did assume a human form to carry out your desire. Now that period is ripe and this is the proper time to inform you of it.

अथ वा विजिगीषा ते सुरलोकाय राघव
सनाथा विष्णुना देवा भवन्तु विगतज्वराः

atha vā vijigīṣā te suralokāya rāghava
sanāthā viṣṇunā devā bhavantu vigatajvarāḥ

O great king, do you wait in this land of mortals if do you wish to govern people for some time more. And if did you wish to repair to the region of immortals, do you again lord over the deities in your Visnu form and let them be freed from anxiety. O Hero, the Patriarch has sent this intelligence to you.

श्रुत्वा पितामहेनोक्तं वाक्यं कालसमीरितम्
राघवः प्रहसन्वाक्यं सर्वसंहारमब्रवीत्

śrutvā pitāmahenoktaṁ vākyaṁ kālasamīritam
rāghavaḥ prahasanvākyaṁ sarvasaṁhāramabravīt
Hearing those unequalled words of the Patriarch from the mouth of Kala, the destroyer of all, Rama smiling said.

श्रुतं मे देवदेवस्य वाक्यं परममद्भुतम्
प्रीतिर्हि महती जाता तवागमनसंभवा

śrutaṁ me devadevasya vākyaṁ paramamadbhutam
prītirhi mahatī jātā tavāgamanasaṁbhavā

I have been greatly pleased and happy for your coming here O my son, I descended on earth to bring about the well-being of the three worlds. May good betide you. I shall now repair to from where I have come here.

मया हि सर्वकृत्येषु देवानां वशवर्तिनाम्
स्थातव्यं सर्वसंहारे यथा ह्याह पितामहः

mayā hi sarvakṛtyeṣu devānāṁ vaśavartinām
sthātavyaṁ sarvasaṁhāre yathā hyāha pitāmahaḥ

I was thinking of this when you did come here. Therefore, I have no doubt in this. O lord of destruction, the immortals are dependent on me, so I shall be with them in all works. The Great Patriarch has said the truth.

तथा तयोः कथयतोर्दुर्वासा भगवानृषिः
रामस्य दर्शनाकाङ्क्षी राजद्वारमुपागमत्

tathā tayoḥ kathayatordurvāsā bhagavānṛṣiḥ
rāmasya darśanākāṅkṣī rājadvāramupāgamat

While Rama and Kala were thus conversing with one another, the great ascetic Durvasa arrived at the gate for seeing Rama and approaching Laksmana said:-O Saumitri, do you soon take me to Rama; my time goes away, so do you take me first.

मुनेस्तु भाषितं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा
अभिवाद्य महात्मानं वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह

munestu bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā lakṣmaṇaḥ paravīrahā
abhivādya mahātmānaṁ vākyametaduvāca ha
Hearing the words of the ascetic, Laksmana, the slayer of enemies worshipping the feet of that high-souled one, said.

किं कार्यं ब्रूहि भगवन्को वार्थः किं करोम्यहम्
व्यग्रो हि राघवो ब्रह्मन्मुहूर्तं वा प्रतीक्षताम्

kiṁ kāryaṁ brūhi bhagavanko vārthaḥ kiṁ karomyaham
vyagro hi rāghavo brahmanmuhūrtaṁ vā pratīkṣatām
O illustrious Sir, kindly mention your business. What is your object? Order me what I am to do. Rama is engaged in some business so kindly wait here for some time.

तच्छ्रुत्वा ऋषिशार्दूलः क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः
उवाच लक्ष्मणं वाक्यं निर्दहन्निव चक्षुषा

tacchrutvā ṛṣiśārdūlaḥ krodhena kaluṣīkṛtaḥ
uvāca lakṣmaṇaṁ vākyaṁ nirdahanniva cakṣuṣā
Hearing those words that foremost of Rsis, red eyes:

अस्मिन्क्षणे मां सौमित्रे रामाय प्रतिवेदय
विषयं त्वां पुरं चैव शपिष्ये राघवं तथा

asminkṣaṇe māṁ saumitre rāmāya prativedaya
viṣayaṁ tvāṁ puraṁ caiva śapiṣye rāghavaṁ tathā

O Saumitri, if do you not go even this very moment and communicate to Rama my arrival, I shall imprecate you, Rama, Bharata, Satrughana, your sons and grand-sons. I shall curse also your kingdom and cities. I cannot any longer restrain by growing ire.

तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसंकाशं वाक्यं तस्य महात्मनः
चिन्तयामास मनसा तस्य वाक्यस्य निश्चयम्

tacchrutvā ghorasaṁkāśaṁ vākyaṁ tasya mahātmanaḥ
cintayāmāsa manasā tasya vākyasya niścayam
Hearing those dreadful and resolute words of the Rsis, Laksmana thought within himself.

एकस्य मरणं मेऽस्तु मा भूत्सर्वविनाशनम्
इति बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य राघवाय न्यवेदयत्

ekasya maraṇaṁ me'stu mā bhūtsarvavināśanam
iti buddhyā viniścitya rāghavāya nyavedayat
My own destruction is far more desirable than that of all. Having thus resolved Laksmana approached Rama and communicated to him the intelligence.

लक्ष्मणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा रामः कालं विसृज्य च
निष्पत्य त्वरितं राजा अत्रेः पुत्रं ददर्श ह

lakṣmaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā rāmaḥ kālaṁ visṛjya ca
niṣpatya tvaritaṁ rājā atreḥ putraṁ dadarśa ha
Hearing the words of Laksmana and having bade adieu, to Kala, Rama soon came out and saw Atri's son.

सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव तेजसा
किं कार्यमिति काकुत्स्थः कृताञ्जलिरभाषत

so'bhivādya mahātmānaṁ jvalantamiva tejasā
kiṁ kāryamiti kākutsthaḥ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
And having saluted that great and powerful ascetic he with folded hands, said. What is your business.

तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा मुनिवरः प्रभुः
प्रत्याह रामं दुर्वासाः श्रूयतां धर्मवत्सल

tadvākyaṁ rāghaveṇoktaṁ śrutvā munivaraḥ prabhuḥ
pratyāha rāmaṁ durvāsāḥ śrūyatāṁ dharmavatsala
Hearing the words of Rama, the highly powerful Durvasa, the foremost of Munis, said. Hear, O Rama fond of virtue.

अद्य वर्षसहस्रस्य समाप्तिर्मम राघव
सोऽहं भोजनमिच्छामि यथासिद्धं तवानघ

adya varṣasahasrasya samāptirmama rāghava
so'haṁ bhojanamicchāmi yathāsiddhaṁ tavānagha
For a thousand years I have carried on the vow of fasting. It has terminated today, so do you give me food as much as possible.

तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं रामो हर्षेण महतान्वितः
भोजनं मुनिमुख्याय यथासिद्धमुपाहरत्

tacchrutvā vacanaṁ rāmo harṣeṇa mahatānvitaḥ
bhojanaṁ munimukhyāya yathāsiddhamupāharat
Hearing those words Rama was greatly delighted and gave proper food to that ascetic.

स तु भुक्त्वा मुनिश्रेष्ठस्तदन्नममृतोपमम्
साधु रामेति संभाष्य स्वमाश्रममुपागमत्

sa tu bhuktvā muniśreṣṭhastadannamamṛtopamam
sādhu rāmeti saṁbhāṣya svamāśramamupāgamat
And feasting on that nectar-like sweet food, Durvasa, the foremost of Rsis, thanked Rama and repaired to his own hermitage.

ततो बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य कालवाक्यानि राघवः
नैतदस्तीति चोक्त्वा स तूष्णीमासीन्महायशाः

tato buddhyā viniścitya kālavākyāni rāghavaḥ
naitadastīti coktvā sa tūṣṇīmāsīnmahāyaśāḥ

There upon remembering the words of Kala, Rama was greatly sorry. And thinking of those dreadful words he was overwhelmed with grief. And with a poorly heart, and face downwards he remained silent for some time. There upon thinking of Kala's words and determining that every calamity would befall him, that highly illustrious descendant, of Raghus, summoned patience.

अवाङ्मुखमथो दीनं दृष्ट्वा सोममिवाप्लुतम्
राघवं लक्ष्मणो वाक्यं हृष्टो मधुरमब्रवीत्

avāṅmukhamatho dīnaṁ dṛṣṭvā somamivāplutam
rāghavaṁ lakṣmaṇo vākyaṁ hṛṣṭo madhuramabravīt
There upon beholding Rama with his head downwards and poorly like to the moon possessed by Rahu, Laksmana, delightedly and with sweet words, said.

न संतापं महाबाहो मदर्थं कर्तुमर्हसि
पूर्वनिर्माणबद्धा हि कालस्य गतिरीदृशी

na saṁtāpaṁ mahābāho madarthaṁ kartumarhasi
pūrvanirmāṇabaddhā hi kālasya gatirīdṛśī
Be not aggrieved for me, O you having mighty' arms. Such is the course of time; the movements of creatures are destined by their pristine actions, good or bad.

जहि मां सौम्य विस्रब्धः प्रतिज्ञां परिपालय
हीनप्रतिज्ञाः काकुत्स्थ प्रयान्ति नरकं नराः

jahi māṁ saumya visrabdhaḥ pratijñāṁ paripālaya
hīnapratijñāḥ kākutstha prayānti narakaṁ narāḥ
O gentle one, do you satisfy your promise of slaying me without any hesitation. O Kakuthstha, those, who cannot carry out their promises, repair to hell.

यदि प्रीतिर्महाराज यद्यनुग्राह्यता मयि
जहि मां निर्विशङ्कस्त्वं धर्मं वर्धय राघव

yadi prītirmahārāja yadyanugrāhyatā mayi
jahi māṁ nirviśaṅkastvaṁ dharmaṁ vardhaya rāghava
O great king, if you have any love or affection for me, do you satisfy your promise by fearlessly slaying me.

लक्ष्मणेन तथोक्तस्तु रामः प्रचलितेन्द्रियः
मन्त्रिणः समुपानीय तथैव च पुरोधसं

lakṣmaṇena tathoktastu rāmaḥ pracalitendriyaḥ
mantriṇaḥ samupānīya tathaiva ca purodhasaṁ

Hearing those words of Laksmana Rama's mind was greatly moved. There upon having invited his priests and ministers there he communicated to them his priests and ministers there he communicated to them his promise and Durvasa's arrival.

तच्छ्रुत्वा मन्त्रिणः सर्वे सोपाध्यायाः समासत
वसिष्ठस्तु महातेजा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह

tacchrutvā mantriṇaḥ sarve sopādhyāyāḥ samāsata
vasiṣṭhastu mahātejā vākyametaduvāca ha
Hearing it the ministers and priests remained silent. There upon Vasistha, of unmitigated effulgence, said.

दृष्टमेतन्महाबाहो क्षयं ते लोमहर्षणम्
लक्ष्मणेन वियोगश्च तव राम महायशः

dṛṣṭametanmahābāho kṣayaṁ te lomaharṣaṇam
lakṣmaṇena viyogaśca tava rāma mahāyaśaḥ
O highly illustrious and mighty armed Rama, I knew before by virtue of my asceticism, of this your present destruction and separation from Laksmana.

त्यजैनं बलवान्कालो मा प्रतिज्ञां वृथा कृथाः
विनष्टायां प्रतिज्ञायां धर्मो हि विलयं व्रजेत्

tyajainaṁ balavānkālo mā pratijñāṁ vṛthā kṛthāḥ
vinaṣṭāyāṁ pratijñāyāṁ dharmo hi vilayaṁ vrajet
Time is powerful; do not falsify your promise. Promise not carried out brings on the destruction of virtue.

ततो धर्मे विनष्टे तु त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरम्
सदेवर्षिगणं सर्वं विनश्येत न संशयः

tato dharme vinaṣṭe tu trailokye sacarācaram
sadevarṣigaṇaṁ sarvaṁ vinaśyeta na saṁśayaḥ
And on the wane of virtue, forsooth, the three worlds, with celestials, saints, mobile and immobile creations, shall be destroyed.

स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल त्रैलोक्यस्याभिपालनम्
लक्ष्मणस्य वधेनाद्य जगत्स्वस्थं कुरुष्व ह

sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla trailokyasyābhipālanam
lakṣmaṇasya vadhenādya jagatsvasthaṁ kuruṣva ha
Therefore, O foremost of men, do you protect, the universe by suffering separation from Laksmana, in the interest of the preservation of the three worlds.

तेषां तत्समवेतानां वाक्यं धर्मार्थसंहितम्
श्रुत्वा परिषदो मध्ये रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्

teṣāṁ tatsamavetānāṁ vākyaṁ dharmārthasaṁhitam
śrutvā pariṣado madhye rāmo lakṣmaṇamabravīt
All other ministers and priests agreed with Vasistha's words. There upon hearing their moral counsels, Rama said to Laksmana before the assembly.

विसर्जये त्वां सौमित्रे मा भूद्धर्मविपर्ययः
त्यागो वधो वा विहितः साधूनामुभयं समम्

visarjaye tvāṁ saumitre mā bhūddharmaviparyayaḥ
tyāgo vadho vā vihitaḥ sādhūnāmubhayaṁ samam
O Laksmana, it is not proper to act against morality, I do therefore renounce you; for the pious hold that destruction and renunciation are all the same.

रामेण भाषिते वाक्ये बाष्पव्याकुलितेक्षणः
लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितः प्रायात्स्वगृहं न विवेश ह

rāmeṇa bhāṣite vākye bāṣpavyākulitekṣaṇaḥ
lakṣmaṇastvaritaḥ prāyātsvagṛhaṁ na viveśa ha
Rama saying this, Laksmana did not go to his own house, but with eyes full of tears specially repaired therefrom.

स गत्वा सरयूतीरमुपस्पृश्य कृताञ्जलिः
निगृह्य सर्वस्रोतांसि निःश्वासं न मुमोच ह

sa gatvā sarayūtīramupaspṛśya kṛtāñjaliḥ
nigṛhya sarvasrotāṁsi niḥśvāsaṁ na mumoca ha
Having reached the banks of Sarayu and rinsed his mouth he stood there with folded palms. And having obstructed all passages he did not breathe any more.

अनुच्छ्वसन्तं युक्तं तं सशक्राः साप्सरोगणाः
देवाः सर्षिगणाः सर्वे पुष्पैरवकिरंस्तदा

anucchvasantaṁ yuktaṁ taṁ saśakrāḥ sāpsarogaṇāḥ
devāḥ sarṣigaṇāḥ sarve puṣpairavakiraṁstadā
Laksmana, the younger brother of Rama, being thus engaged in penances, having obstructed his breath, Apsaras, Indra and other deities and Rsis showered flowers on him.

अदृश्यं सर्वमनुजैः सशरीरं महाबलम्
प्रगृह्य लक्ष्मणं शक्रो दिवं संप्रविवेश ह

adṛśyaṁ sarvamanujaiḥ saśarīraṁ mahābalam
pragṛhya lakṣmaṇaṁ śakro divaṁ saṁpraviveśa ha
There upon beyond the sight of men, having taken the highly powerful Laksmana within his body, the king of celestials entered his own city.

ततो विष्णोश्चतुर्भागमागतं सुरसत्तमाः
हृष्टाः प्रमुदिताः सर्वेऽपूजयनृषिभिः सह

tato viṣṇoścaturbhāgamāgataṁ surasattamāḥ
hṛṣṭāḥ pramuditāḥ sarve'pūjayanṛṣibhiḥ saha
There upon beholding Laksmana, the fourth portion of Visnu arrived at their city the celestials were greatly delighted and engaged in his worship.

विसृज्य लक्ष्मणं रामो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः
पुरोधसं मन्त्रिणश्च नैगमांश्चेदमब्रवीत्

visṛjya lakṣmaṇaṁ rāmo duḥkhaśokasamanvitaḥ
purodhasaṁ mantriṇaśca naigamāṁścedamabravīt
Having forsaken Laksmana and being stricken with sorrow and grief Rama said to his citizens and ministers.

अद्य राज्येऽभिषेक्ष्यामि भरतं धर्मवत्सलम्
अयोध्यायां पतिं वीरं ततो यास्याम्यहं वनम्

adya rājye'bhiṣekṣyāmi bharataṁ dharmavatsalam
ayodhyāyāṁ patiṁ vīraṁ tato yāsyāmyahaṁ vanam
Having placed the pious and heroic Bharata on the throne of Ayodhya I shall today repair to woods.

प्रवेशयत संभारान्मा भूत्कालात्ययो यथा
अद्यैवाहं गमिष्यामि लक्ष्मणेन गतां गतिम्

praveśayata saṁbhārānmā bhūtkālātyayo yathā
adyaivāhaṁ gamiṣyāmi lakṣmaṇena gatāṁ gatim
Do you, without any delay collect there all articles of installation. I shall follow the way which has been wended by Laksmana.

तच्छ्रुत्वा राघवेणोक्तं सर्वाः प्रकृतयो भृशम्
मूर्धभिः प्रणता भूमौ गतसत्त्वा इवाभवन्

tacchrutvā rāghaveṇoktaṁ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo bhṛśam
mūrdhabhiḥ praṇatā bhūmau gatasattvā ivābhavan
Hearing the words of Raghava, the subjects with their heads downwards remained motionless like so many dead bodies.

भरतश्च विसंज्ञोऽभूच्छ्रुत्वा रामस्य भाषितम्
राज्यं विगर्हयामास राघवं चेदमब्रवीत्

bharataśca visaṁjño'bhūcchrutvā rāmasya bhāṣitam
rājyaṁ vigarhayāmāsa rāghavaṁ cedamabravīt
Hearing Rama's words Bharata was also stupified and speaking ill of the kingdom, said.

इमौ कुशीलवौ राजन्नभिषिञ्च नराधिप
कोसलेषु कुशं वीरमुत्तरेषु तथा लवम्

imau kuśīlavau rājannabhiṣiñca narādhipa
kosaleṣu kuśaṁ vīramuttareṣu tathā lavam
O King, I swear by truth, that far from kingdom I do not wish to live in heaven even without you; O King, of these two princes, Kusi and Lava do you place Kusi in Kosala and Lava in North Kosala.

शत्रुघ्नस्य तु गच्छन्तु दूतास्त्वरितविक्रमाः
इदं गमनमस्माकं स्वर्गायाख्यान्तु माचिरम्

śatrughnasya tu gacchantu dūtāstvaritavikramāḥ
idaṁ gamanamasmākaṁ svargāyākhyāntu māciram
And let quick-moving emissaries go to Satrughna and communicate to him the intelligence of our going there.

तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतेनोक्तं दृष्ट्वा चापि ह्यधोमुखान्
पौरान्दुःखेन संतप्तान्वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्

tacchrutvā bharatenoktaṁ dṛṣṭvā cāpi hyadhomukhān
paurānduḥkhena saṁtaptānvasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt
Hearing those words of Bharata and beholding the subjects stricken with sorrow having their heads downwards, Vasistha said.

वत्स राम इमाः पश्य धरणीं प्रकृतीर्गताः
ज्ञात्वैषामीप्सितं कार्यं मा चैषां विप्रियं कृथाः

vatsa rāma imāḥ paśya dharaṇīṁ prakṛtīrgatāḥ
jñātvaiṣāmīpsitaṁ kāryaṁ mā caiṣāṁ vipriyaṁ kṛthāḥ
Behold, O Rama, the subjects have placed themselves on the ground. Do you, therefore; apprised of their intention, satisfy their desire.

वसिष्ठस्य तु वाक्येन उत्थाप्य प्रकृतीजनम्
किं करोमीति काकुत्स्थः सर्वान्वचनमब्रवीत्

vasiṣṭhasya tu vākyena utthāpya prakṛtījanam
kiṁ karomīti kākutsthaḥ sarvānvacanamabravīt
Raising up the subjects according to the words of Vasistha Rama said:-What good can I do for you.

ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो रामं वचनमब्रुवन्
गच्छन्तमनुगच्छामो यतो राम गमिष्यसि

tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo rāmaṁ vacanamabruvan
gacchantamanugacchāmo yato rāma gamiṣyasi
Hearing Rama's words they said:-0 King, we shall follow you wherever you shall go.

एषा नः परमा प्रीतिरेष धर्मः परो मतः
हृद्गता नः सदा तुष्टिस्तवानुगमने दृढा

eṣā naḥ paramā prītireṣa dharmaḥ paro mataḥ
hṛdgatā naḥ sadā tuṣṭistavānugamane dṛḍhā
O great king, by this we shall be greatly delighted. We pray for this boon only. Our delight consists in following you in everything.

पौरेषु यदि ते प्रीतिर्यदि स्नेहो ह्यनुत्तमः
सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थ समं गच्छाम सत्पथम्

paureṣu yadi te prītiryadi sneho hyanuttamaḥ
saputradārāḥ kākutstha samaṁ gacchāma satpatham
If you have any love or affection for the citizens do you permit them that they may follow your good path with their wives and children.

तपोवनं वा दुर्गं वा नदीमम्भोनिधिं तथा
वयं ते यदि न त्याज्याः सर्वान्नो नय ईश्वर

tapovanaṁ vā durgaṁ vā nadīmambhonidhiṁ tathā
vayaṁ te yadi na tyājyāḥ sarvānno naya īśvara
O lord, if you do not forsake us, let us all go wherever you silt,-be it a forest an intractable tract, a river or an ocean.

ते दूता रामवाक्येन चोदिता लघुविक्रमाः
प्रजग्मुर्मधुरां शीघ्रं चक्रुर्वासं न चाध्वनि

te dūtā rāmavākyena coditā laghuvikramāḥ
prajagmurmadhurāṁ śīghraṁ cakrurvāsaṁ na cādhvani
Having been despatched by Rama, quickmoving emissaries speedily arrived at Mathura.

ततस्त्रिभिरहोरात्रैः संप्राप्य मधुरामथ
शत्रुघ्नाय यथावृत्तमाचख्युः सर्वमेव तत्

tatastribhirahorātraiḥ saṁprāpya madhurāmatha
śatrughnāya yathāvṛttamācakhyuḥ sarvameva tat
Continually travelling for three nights and days, they arrived there and communicated to Satrughna the intelligence.

लक्ष्मणस्य परित्यागं प्रतिज्ञां राघवस्य च
पुत्रयोरभिषेकं च पौरानुगमनं तथा

lakṣmaṇasya parityāgaṁ pratijñāṁ rāghavasya ca
putrayorabhiṣekaṁ ca paurānugamanaṁ tathā

Having informed him of the renouncing of Laksmana, Rama's promise and the following of the citizens they said:-The intelligent Rama has reared for Kusi the spacious city of Kusavati at the foot of the Vindhya range.

श्राविता च पुरी रम्या श्रावतीति लवस्य च
अयोध्यां विजनां चैव भरतं राघवानुगम्

śrāvitā ca purī ramyā śrāvatīti lavasya ca
ayodhyāṁ vijanāṁ caiva bharataṁ rāghavānugam

The city of Sravasti has been reared for Lava, and the mighty car-warriors Rama and Bharata, making Ayodhya void of men, have addressed themselves for repairing to heaven. Having speedily communicated to him this intelligence the emissaries took rest.

एवं सर्वं निवेद्याशु शत्रुघ्नाय महात्मने
विरेमुस्ते ततो दूतास्त्वर राजन्निति ब्रुवन्

evaṁ sarvaṁ nivedyāśu śatrughnāya mahātmane
viremuste tato dūtāstvara rājanniti bruvan
There upon they asked Satrughna to proceed soon. Observing the dreadful destruction of his race, Satrughna sent for his subjects and priests and informed them of everything.

तेषां सर्वं यथावृत्तमाख्याय रघुनन्दनः
आत्मनश्च विपर्यासं भविष्यं भ्रातृभिः सह

teṣāṁ sarvaṁ yathāvṛttamākhyāya raghunandanaḥ
ātmanaśca viparyāsaṁ bhaviṣyaṁ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
He also communicated to them his own destruction with his brothers. There upon the king Satrughna determined upon installing his two sons in the kingdom.

द्विधाकृत्वा तु तां सेनां माधुरीं पुत्रयोर्द्वयोः
धनधान्यसमायुक्तौ स्थापयामास पार्थिवौ

dvidhākṛtvā tu tāṁ senāṁ mādhurīṁ putrayordvayoḥ
dhanadhānyasamāyuktau sthāpayāmāsa pārthivau

Subahu was placed on the throne of Mathura and Satrughati became the king of Vidisa. Having thus established Subahu in Mathura, and Satrughati in Vidisa, the great hero Satrughna ascended his car and went to Ayodhya.

सोऽभिवाद्य ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतेन्द्रियः
उवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञो धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन्

so'bhivādya tato rāmaṁ prāñjaliḥ prayatendriyaḥ
uvāca vākyaṁ dharmajño dharmamevānucintayan

And there he saw the great Rama, clothed in silk raiment burning like fire in the midst of the ascetics. There upon remembering his duty he saluted Rama, conversant with piety and with folded hands said.

तस्य वाक्यस्य वाक्यान्ते वानराः कामरूपिणः
ऋक्षराक्षससंघाश्च समापेतुरनेकशः

tasya vākyasya vākyānte vānarāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ
ṛkṣarākṣasasaṁghāśca samāpeturanekaśaḥ
Immediately after Rama had said this, monkeys assuming shapes at will bears and Raksasas, began to assemble there.

देवपुत्रा ऋषिसुता गन्धर्वाणां सुतास्तथा
रामक्षयं विदित्वा ते सर्व एव समागताः

devaputrā ṛṣisutā gandharvāṇāṁ sutāstathā
rāmakṣayaṁ viditvā te sarva eva samāgatāḥ
Apprised of Rama's determination of going to heaven, monkeys, born of the celestials, Rsis and Gandharvas taking Sugriva before them, came there to see Rama.

प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पृथुवक्षा महायशाः
रामः कमलपत्राक्षः पुरोधसमथाब्रवीत्

prabhātāyāṁ tu śarvaryāṁ pṛthuvakṣā mahāyaśāḥ
rāmaḥ kamalapatrākṣaḥ purodhasamathābravīt
After the night had expired the highly illustrious Rama having a spacious breast and eyes like lotus petals said to the priest.

अग्निहोत्रं व्रजत्वग्रे सर्पिर्ज्वलितपावकम्
वाजपेयातपत्रं च शोभयानं महापथम्

agnihotraṁ vrajatvagre sarpirjvalitapāvakam
vājapeyātapatraṁ ca śobhayānaṁ mahāpatham
Let the brilliant umbrellas Agnihotra, and Vajapeya go with the Brahmanas before, which look well in the great road.

ततो वसिष्ठस्तेजस्वी सर्वं निरवशेषतः
चकार विधिवद्धर्म्यं महाप्रास्थानिकं विधिम्

tato vasiṣṭhastejasvī sarvaṁ niravaśeṣataḥ
cakāra vidhivaddharmyaṁ mahāprāsthānikaṁ vidhim
There upon the highly effulgent Vasistha arranged duly all the ceremonies necessary for going to the next world.

ततः क्षौमाम्बरधरो ब्रह्म चावर्तयन्परम्
कुशान्गृहीत्वा पाणिभ्यां प्रसज्य प्रययावथ

tataḥ kṣaumāmbaradharo brahma cāvartayanparam
kuśāngṛhītvā pāṇibhyāṁ prasajya prayayāvatha
There upon wearing a thin cloth, holding Kusa grass by his fingers, and reciting Vedic hymns he proceeded to the banks of Sarayu.

अव्याहरन्क्वचित्किंचिन्निश्चेष्टो निःसुखः पथि
निर्जगाम गृहात्तस्माद्दीप्यमानो यथांशुमान्

avyāharankvacitkiṁcinniśceṣṭo niḥsukhaḥ pathi
nirjagāma gṛhāttasmāddīpyamāno yathāṁśumān
Having given up all actions of senses, and suffered the pains of going on foot he issued out of the city speechless like to the burning sun.

रामस्य पार्श्वे सव्ये तु पद्मा श्रीः सुसमाहिता
दक्षिणे ह्रीर्विशालाक्षी व्यवसायस्तथाग्रतः

rāmasya pārśve savye tu padmā śrīḥ susamāhitā
dakṣiṇe hrīrviśālākṣī vyavasāyastathāgrataḥ

On his right hand side was the lotus-handed Sri, on his left hand side was the goddess. Earth and before him was the power of destruction. Various arrows, huge bows, and daggers, assuming forms followed him.

वेदा ब्राह्मणरूपेण सावित्री सर्वरक्षिणी
ओंकारोऽथ वषट्कारः सर्वे राममनुव्रताः

vedā brāhmaṇarūpeṇa sāvitrī sarvarakṣiṇī
oṁkāro'tha vaṣaṭkāraḥ sarve rāmamanuvratāḥ
And also went with him the four Vedas in the shape of the Brahmanas, the all protecting Gayatri, Omkara and Vasatkara.

ऋषयश्च महात्मानः सर्व एव महीसुराः
अन्वगच्छन्त काकुत्स्थं स्वर्गद्वारमुपागतम्

ṛṣayaśca mahātmānaḥ sarva eva mahīsurāḥ
anvagacchanta kākutsthaṁ svargadvāramupāgatam
The high-souled Rsis and great Asuras followed the high-souled Rama to the open gates of heaven.

तं यान्तमनुयान्ति स्म अन्तःपुरचराः स्त्रियः
सवृद्धबालदासीकाः सवर्षवरकिंकराः

taṁ yāntamanuyānti sma antaḥpuracarāḥ striyaḥ
savṛddhabāladāsīkāḥ savarṣavarakiṁkarāḥ
All the female servants, old and young, the damsels of the seraglio accompanied by servants having no manhood, Bharata and Laksmana accompanied by their wives, followed him with Agnihotra.

रामव्रतमुपागम्य राघवं समनुव्रताः
ततो विप्रा महात्मानः साग्निहोत्राः समाहिताः
सपुत्रदाराः काकुत्स्थमन्वगच्छन्महामतिम्

rāmavratamupāgamya rāghavaṁ samanuvratāḥ
tato viprā mahātmānaḥ sāgnihotrāḥ samāhitāḥ
saputradārāḥ kākutsthamanvagacchanmahāmatim
All those high-souled ones, assembled there with Agnihotra and followed Kakutstha with their wives and children.

मन्त्रिणो भृत्यवर्गाश्च सपुत्राः सहबान्धवाः
सानुगा राघवं सर्वे अन्वगच्छन्प्रहृष्टवत्

mantriṇo bhṛtyavargāśca saputrāḥ sahabāndhavāḥ
sānugā rāghavaṁ sarve anvagacchanprahṛṣṭavat
The ministers and the servants, with their sons, beasts and friends, followed Rama delightedly.

ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः
अनुजग्मुः प्रगच्छन्तं राघवं गुणरञ्जिताः

tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtāḥ
anujagmuḥ pragacchantaṁ rāghavaṁ guṇarañjitāḥ
There upon all the subjects healthy and delighted went after Raghava, attracted by his accomplishments and cleansed of their sins.

स्नातं प्रमुदितं सर्वं हृष्टपुष्टमनुत्तमम्
दृप्तं किलिकिलाशब्दैः सर्वं राममनुव्रतम्

snātaṁ pramuditaṁ sarvaṁ hṛṣṭapuṣṭamanuttamam
dṛptaṁ kilikilāśabdaiḥ sarvaṁ rāmamanuvratam
All the females and males, with their beasts, birds and friends, delightedly followed Raghava. Bathed and delighted all the monkeys, healthy and joyous following Rama, created a continued tumult.

न तत्र कश्चिद्दीनोऽभूद्व्रीडितो वापि दुःखितः
हृष्टं प्रमुदितं सर्वं बभूव परमाद्भुतम्

na tatra kaściddīno'bhūdvrīḍito vāpi duḥkhitaḥ
hṛṣṭaṁ pramuditaṁ sarvaṁ babhūva paramādbhutam
There was none poorly, aggrieved or miserable—all of them appeared wonderfully happy and delighted.

द्रष्टुकामोऽथ निर्याणं राज्ञो जानपदो जनः
संप्राप्तः सोऽपि दृष्ट्वैव सह सर्वैरनुव्रतः

draṣṭukāmo'tha niryāṇaṁ rājño jānapado janaḥ
saṁprāptaḥ so'pi dṛṣṭvaiva saha sarvairanuvrataḥ
When Rama issued out of the city, whoever came to see him followed him being desirous of going to heaven.

ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि जनाश्च पुरवासिनः
अगछन्परया भक्त्या पृष्ठतः सुसमाहिताः

ṛkṣavānararakṣāṁsi janāśca puravāsinaḥ
agachanparayā bhaktyā pṛṣṭhataḥ susamāhitāḥ
Bears, monkeys and Raksasas and all the citizens, followed him with great devotion and collected minds.

अध्यर्धयोजनं गत्वा नदीं पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम्
सरयूं पुण्यसलिलां ददर्श रघुनन्दनः

adhyardhayojanaṁ gatvā nadīṁ paścānmukhāśritām
sarayūṁ puṇyasalilāṁ dadarśa raghunandanaḥ
Having thus gone for more than a half Yojana, the descendant of Raghu, espied Surayu of holy waters flowing towards the west.

आययौ यत्र काकुत्स्थः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितः
विमानशतकोटीभिर्दिव्याभिरभिसंवृतः

āyayau yatra kākutsthaḥ svargāya samupasthitaḥ
vimānaśatakoṭībhirdivyābhirabhisaṁvṛtaḥ

There upon at that moment, Brahma, the grandfather of all encircled by all high-souled deities and with hundred kotis of celestial cars, arrived there where Kakutstha had addressed himself to repair to heaven.
पपात पुष्पवृष्टिश्च वायुमुक्ता महौघवत्
papāta puṣpavṛṣṭiśca vāyumuktā mahaughavat
There blew the holy, fragrant and delightful winds and there fell profusely celestial flowers from the hands of the deities.

तस्मिंस्तूर्यशताकीर्णे गन्धर्वाप्सरसंकुले
सरयूसलिलं रामः पद्भ्यां समुपचक्रमे

tasmiṁstūryaśatākīrṇe gandharvāpsarasaṁkule
sarayūsalilaṁ rāmaḥ padbhyāṁ samupacakrame
The place was filled with the noise of hundreds of bugles sounded by Gandharvas and Apsaras. And then Rama prepared himself to descend to the waters of Sarayu.

पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा विनिश्चित्य महामतिः
विवेश वैष्णवं तेजः सशरीरः सहानुजः

pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā viniścitya mahāmatiḥ
viveśa vaiṣṇavaṁ tejaḥ saśarīraḥ sahānujaḥ
Hearing the words of the Patriarch and determining everything the high-minded Rama entered there bodily with his brothers in his Visnu form.

ततो विष्णुगतं देवं पूजयन्ति स्म देवताः
साध्या मरुद्गणाश्चैव सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः

tato viṣṇugataṁ devaṁ pūjayanti sma devatāḥ
sādhyā marudgaṇāścaiva sendrāḥ sāgnipurogamāḥ
There upon all the celestials Sadhyas Marutas, headed by Indra and Agni worshipped that deity, Visnu.

ये च दिव्या ऋषिगणा गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च याः
सुपर्णनागयक्षाश्च दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः

ye ca divyā ṛṣigaṇā gandharvāpsarasaśca yāḥ
suparṇanāgayakṣāśca daityadānavarākṣasāḥ

So did all the celestial Rsis, Gandharvas Apsaras, Suparnas, Nagas, Yaksas, demons, Danavas and Raksasas. There upon eulogising him the celestials said: Our region is now freed from sins and all here have been delighted and all their desires have been fulfilled.

अथ विष्णुर्महातेजाः पितामहमुवाच ह
एषां लोकाञ्जनौघानां दातुमर्हसि सुव्रत

atha viṣṇurmahātejāḥ pitāmahamuvāca ha
eṣāṁ lokāñjanaughānāṁ dātumarhasi suvrata
There upon the highly effulgent Visnu said to the Patriarch Brahma:-It behove you, O you of good vows, to allot to those people their proper regions.

इमे हि सर्वे स्नेहान्मामनुयाता मनस्विनः
भक्ता भाजयितव्याश्च त्यक्तात्मानश्च मत्कृते

ime hi sarve snehānmāmanuyātā manasvinaḥ
bhaktā bhājayitavyāśca tyaktātmānaśca matkṛte
These illustrious ones have followed me out of love. They are worthy of my respect for they are my devotees and have renounced their persons for me.

तच्छ्रुत्वा विष्णुवचनं ब्रह्मा लोकगुरुः प्रभुः
लोकान्सान्तानिकान्नाम यास्यन्तीमे समागताः

tacchrutvā viṣṇuvacanaṁ brahmā lokaguruḥ prabhuḥ
lokānsāntānikānnāma yāsyantīme samāgatāḥ
Hearing the words of Visnu, the lord Brahma, father of all creatures, said:-All these people who have come here shall go to the region named Santanaka.

यच्च तिर्यग्गतं किंचिद्राममेवानुचिन्तयत्
प्राणांस्त्यक्ष्यति भक्त्या वै संताने तु निवत्स्यति
सर्वैरेव गुणैर्युक्ते ब्रह्मलोकादनन्तरे

yacca tiryaggataṁ kiṁcidrāmamevānucintayat
prāṇāṁstyakṣyati bhaktyā vai saṁtāne tu nivatsyati
sarvaireva guṇairyukte brahmalokādanantare

This region is intended even for him, who though born in the most degraded state, thinks of all objects as Visnu. There is no question about their attaining to this region who, out of devotion, have followed you and renounced their persons. This region has the attributes of the Brahma region and is next to it.

तथोक्तवति देवेशे गोप्रतारमुपागताः
भेजिरे सरयूं सर्वे हर्षपूर्णाश्रुविक्लवाः

tathoktavati deveśe gopratāramupāgatāḥ
bhejire sarayūṁ sarve harṣapūrṇāśruviklavāḥ
The lord of the deities having said this, all those who were present at the holy pilgrimage of Gopratara descended into the waters of Sarayu with eyes full of tears of joy.

अवगाह्य जलं यो यः प्राणी ह्यासीत्प्रहृष्टवत्
मानुषं देहमुत्सृज्य विमानं सोऽध्यरोहत

avagāhya jalaṁ yo yaḥ prāṇī hyāsītprahṛṣṭavat
mānuṣaṁ dehamutsṛjya vimānaṁ so'dhyarohata
Having bathed there, given up their lives delightedly and renounced their human forms they ascended the celestial cars.

तिर्यग्योनिगताश्चापि संप्राप्ताः सरयूजलम्
दिव्या दिव्येन वपुषा देवा दीप्ता इवाभवन्

tiryagyonigatāścāpi saṁprāptāḥ sarayūjalam
divyā divyena vapuṣā devā dīptā ivābhavan

And having obtained the waters of Sarayu, hundreds of those that were born in the race of birds attained to the land of immortals obtaining the respective celestial forms (they had before). And in those celestial forms, they looked effulgent like the deities.

गत्वा तु सरयूतोयं स्थावराणि चराणि च
प्राप्य तत्तोयविक्लेदं देवलोकमुपागमन्

gatvā tu sarayūtoyaṁ sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
prāpya tattoyavikledaṁ devalokamupāgaman
And going to the waters of Sarayu all objects, mobile and immobile, having bathed there, repaired to the excellent celestial region.

तथा स्वर्गगतं सर्वं कृत्वा लोकगुरुर्दिवम्
जगाम त्रिदशैः सार्धं हृष्टैर्हृष्टो महामतिः

tathā svargagataṁ sarvaṁ kṛtvā lokagururdivam
jagāma tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṁ hṛṣṭairhṛṣṭo mahāmatiḥ
Having thus settled in heaven all those arrived there the father, of creatures with the deities, delighted and happy, repaired to the highest heaven.

एतावदेव आख्यानं सोत्तरं ब्रह्मपूजितम्
रामायणमिति ख्यातं मुख्यं वाल्मीकिना कृतम्

etāvadeva ākhyānaṁ sottaraṁ brahmapūjitam
rāmāyaṇamiti khyātaṁ mukhyaṁ vālmīkinā kṛtam
This Story ends with the Uttara. It is held in reverence by Brahma composed by Valmiki and passes as the foremost of all under the name of the Ramayana.
